messages:
maya: opened a quick PR to fix /generate streaming examples. noticed mismatch between examples and the OpenAPI streaming contract: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/13012
derek: what's the mismatch?
maya: a couple of things: 1) examples show a JSON array arriving over the wire (like [ {..}, {..} ]) but our streaming path uses SSE with text/event-stream where each event is a partial `output` object. 2) examples don't set Accept header to text/event-stream in the curl snippets. users copy+pasting got plain JSON and then wondered why the client blocked
sophie: ouch. that would break naive fetch() consumers. can you paste the corrected curl streaming example here?
maya: sure, corrected curl for streaming (SSE):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "x-request-id: $(uuidgen)" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=redwood/stream-1&stream=true"
```
derek: also include a short example of the SSE payload so folks know how to parse it.
maya: added SSE payload example in the PR:
```
event: output
data: {"id":"gen_01A...","delta":{"text":"Hel"}}

event: output
data: {"id":"gen_01A...","delta":{"text":"lo"}}

event: done
data: {"id":"gen_01A...","outputs":[{"text":"Hello"}]}
```
docs-ci-bot: docs lint failed 
- streaming examples must use `text/event-stream` and match OpenAPI streaming contract
- non-streaming response sample found in streaming example file

maya: fixing now: removed the JSON-array example and added the SSE example + a note: "Use Accept: text/event-stream and parse SSE events; examples use event `output` for deltas and event `done` for final result."
derek: please add a warning for SDK snippet parity: JS SDK returns an async iterator of chunks, while curl shows raw SSE; add a small note so folks know mapping (SSE -> iterator chunks).
maya: will add a short mapping note and update the JS snippet to show for-await-of parsing.
eng-oncall: from runtime side, this is safe. just flagging that changing docs for streaming format might surface users who expect JSON arrays; include a changelog bullet and migration note.
sophie: can we add a tiny test that validates streaming example headers and that the example file doesn't include full JSON body for streaming? follow-up issue ok.
maya: filed follow-up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4367 for snapshot tests and added changelog entry under "Docs: streaming examples clarified"
docs-ci-bot: re-run lint: all checks passed \u2705
derek: LGTM. rebase on main and ping reviewers. thanks for catching this Maya :raised_hands:
